discourse.title: Your Reality Is In Your Own Self, Not Elsewhere
discourse.excerpt: Man need not undertake any special sadhanas (spiritual exercises) to visualise the all-pervading truth. We call God by different names like Brahma, Vishnu, and Maheswara. These are the names given by man to God based on some imaginary forms. But who has actually perceived these forms? None so far. There is only one power in the world, which is all-pervasive. That is the power of love.
discourse.theme: Your reality is in your own self, not elsewhere — the power of love is the Atmic power.

reflection: Why do you run outside looking for God, Swami asks, when the power you seek is already inside you? You need no special sadhana to see the truth — only the willingness to turn inward. The love that holds the stars in the sky is the same love beating in your chest. So today, stop searching. Sit quietly, feel the love that is already there, and recognize: this is your reality. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 37, 25 Oct 2004)
seva_nudge: Sit quietly for five minutes and turn your attention to your own heartbeat — then thank God for the love already inside you.
